digest.component_or_area: pytest fixtures and test environment handling
propositions: Seven pytest fixtures return complete copies of os.environ directly or nested in rendered objects, exposing arbitrary ambient credentials when pytest renders fixture arguments during traceback output
Pytest default long traceback renders fixture/test arguments using saferepr, causing inherited environment variables positioned early in insertion-order to leak into test output on assertion failures
Minimal-environment test runs under env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin pass for all affected fixtures, proving no behavioral requirement depends on arbitrary ambient inheritance
Each fixture requires only explicit allowlisted environment variables: fake-bin-first PATH plus harness-specific state/path variables, with per-test mutable overrides preserved
Replacement of broad os.environ copies with explicit allowlisted mappings eliminates credential leakage in long traceback while maintaining fixture mutability and fake-bin PATH availability
